decision.explanation: The query asks for the establishment date of 'Marina High School'. The provided sources describe five distinct entities sharing this name but located in different cities or having different operational histories: 1) Marina High School in Huntington Beach, CA (operating since 1963 per D1S1); 2) Marina High School in Huntington Beach, CA (Open Date listed as September 1, 1985 per D2S3); 3) Marina High School in Huntington Beach, CA (operating since 1955 per D3S1); 4) Marina High School in San Leandro, CA (operating from 1964 per D4S1); and 5) Marina High School in Marina, CA (operating since 2006 per D5S3). Since the question does not specify a location, all distinct valid referents and their corresponding establishment dates found in the source text must be included as complementary answers.
